summary.en: The world's largest manufacturing base. Countless consumer goods begin their journey here, and its export network reaches nearly every economy.
summary.zh: 全球规模最大的制造业基地。大量消费品从这里出发，出口网络几乎覆盖每一个经济体。

exports.en: Machinery, electronics, textiles and consumer goods
exports.zh: 机械设备、电子产品、纺织品与消费品

strength.en: Dense industrial clusters — components and finished goods can be completed within the same region.
strength.zh: 产业集群密集——零部件到成品可在同一区域内完成配套。

risk.en: Heavy export dependence means local disruptions can cascade through global networks quickly.
risk.zh: 高度依赖出口，本地扰动会迅速传导至全球网络。

summary.en: One of the largest import markets in the world. Demand from its retailers and technology firms shapes trans-Pacific freight flows.
summary.zh: 全球最大的进口市场之一。零售与科技企业的需求塑造着跨太平洋的货物流向。

exports.en: Capital goods, aircraft, semiconductors and agricultural products
exports.zh: 资本设备、飞机、半导体与农产品

strength.en: Enormous, stable end demand backed by a mature distribution network.
strength.zh: 终端需求庞大且稳定，分销网络成熟。

risk.en: Imports concentrate in a handful of West Coast gateways, so congestion spreads nationwide.
risk.zh: 进口高度集中于少数西海岸门户港口，拥堵会扩散至全国。

summary.en: Known for precision components, advanced materials and the automotive industry — often sitting upstream in critical supply chains.
summary.zh: 以精密零部件、先进材料与汽车工业著称，常处在关键供应链的上游环节。

exports.en: Automobiles, precision machinery, electronic components and materials
exports.zh: 汽车、精密机械、电子零部件与材料

strength.en: Hard to replace in upstream materials and core components.
strength.zh: 在上游材料与核心零部件环节难以替代。

risk.en: Frequent natural disasters combined with an export-led economy create recurring exposure.
risk.zh: 自然灾害频发，叠加出口导向型经济，风险敞口反复出现。

summary.en: Europe's largest economy. Its automotive, machinery and chemical exports underpin the wider European manufacturing network.
summary.zh: 欧洲最大经济体。汽车、机械与化工出口支撑着整个欧洲制造网络。

exports.en: Automobiles, machinery, chemicals and industrial equipment
exports.zh: 汽车、机械设备、化工产品与工业装备

strength.en: High-end manufacturing combined with a central logistics position in Europe.
strength.zh: 高端制造能力叠加位于欧洲中部的物流位置。

risk.en: Energy dependence and export orientation make it sensitive to geopolitical shocks.
risk.zh: 能源依赖与出口导向使其对地缘冲击高度敏感。

summary.en: Guarding the entrance to the Strait of Malacca, it is one of the world's most important container transshipment and bunkering hubs.
summary.zh: 扼守马六甲海峡出入口，是全球最重要的集装箱中转与船舶加油枢纽之一。

exports.en: Refined petroleum, chemicals and re-exported electronics
exports.zh: 成品油、化工产品与转口电子产品

strength.en: Geographic position paired with unusually efficient port operations.
strength.zh: 地理位置优越，配合极高的港口运营效率。

risk.en: Almost entirely dependent on transit volumes and regional trade patterns; rival ports compete aggressively.
risk.zh: 几乎完全依赖中转货量与区域贸易格局，周边港口竞争激烈。

summary.en: A global leader in semiconductors, shipbuilding and automobiles, sitting at chokepoints of several high-technology supply chains.
summary.zh: 在半导体、造船与汽车领域全球领先，处于多条高科技供应链的咽喉位置。

exports.zh: 半导体、船舶、汽车与石化产品

strength.en: Dominant global share in memory chips and shipbuilding.
strength.zh: 在存储芯片与造船领域占据全球主导份额。

risk.en: Highly concentrated exports mean a shock in one industry moves the whole economy.
risk.zh: 出口集中度过高，单一产业波动会牵动整体经济。

summary.en: A primary destination for manufacturing capacity relocating out of China, now a major base for electronics assembly and garments.
summary.zh: 承接制造业产能转移的主要目的地，已成为电子组装与纺织服装的重要基地。

exports.en: Electronics assembly, textiles, footwear and furniture
exports.zh: 电子组装、纺织品、鞋类与家具

strength.en: Cost advantage with close proximity to established Chinese supply chains.
strength.zh: 成本优势明显，且紧邻成熟的中国供应链。

risk.en: Infrastructure and power supply struggle to keep pace with rapid capacity expansion.
risk.zh: 基础设施与电力供应难以跟上产能的快速扩张。

summary.en: Huge domestic demand alongside fast-growing manufacturing, making it a key destination for supply chain diversification.
summary.zh: 庞大的内需与快速增长的制造业并存，是供应链多元化的重要目的地。

exports.en: Pharmaceuticals, refined petroleum, textiles and engineering goods
exports.zh: 药品、成品油、纺织品与工程制品

strength.en: A large labour force paired with a fast-growing domestic market.
strength.zh: 劳动力规模庞大，且内需市场增长迅速。

risk.en: Logistics efficiency, customs procedures and infrastructure remain persistent bottlenecks.
risk.zh: 物流效率、通关流程与基础设施仍是长期瓶颈。
